about: Body regions. Texts by the health lead (translated). CC BY 4.0. Alerts not clinically validated.

regions.name: Brain & mood
regions.space_effect: Isolation, schedules and the environment can affect sleep and performance.
regions.how_measured: Sleep self-report, questionnaires, actigraphy if available; voice of the daily message; 3-minute reaction test.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.resources_note: No specific device in the inventory; actigraph NOT INVENTORIED.
regions.status: PARTIAL: ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Eyes
regions.space_effect: Fluid shifts towards the head are linked to neuro-ocular changes during long flights. Optic disc edema on OCT in 9 of 13 crew by day 150.
regions.how_measured: Visual acuity, fundus photography and OCT, depending on equipment and protocol.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.status: DESCRIPTION SUPPORTED; ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Neck
regions.risk: Altered flow and jugular vein thrombosis
regions.space_effect: In microgravity the flow in the jugular veins can change, even without symptoms (abnormal flow in 6 of 11 crew, one thrombus).
regions.how_measured: Jugular Doppler ultrasound, performed according to training and protocol.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.status: DESCRIPTION SUPPORTED; ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Heart
regions.space_effect: Microgravity changes fluid distribution and can reduce tolerance to standing up after flight. 24-h blood pressure drops 8-10 mmHg in flight while heart rate does not change (Norsk 2015).
regions.how_measured: Pulse (Bio-Monitor; camera as a plus), blood pressure and symptoms.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.status: PARTIAL: ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Lungs
regions.space_effect: The closed cabin requires CO2 control; build-up can cause discomfort and lower performance (symptoms reported from 2.3 mmHg; ISS limit 3.0 mmHg).
regions.how_measured: Cabin CO2 sensor and, for the crew member, breathing rate and SpO2 if needed.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.status: DESCRIPTION SUPPORTED; ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Bones & muscles
regions.space_effect: Long unloading favours loss of muscle mass and strength and bone loss (about 1-1.5% bone density per month).
regions.how_measured: Exercise log, body mass, functional tests; DXA mainly before and after flight.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.resources_note: No densitometer or dynamometer in the inventory.
regions.status: PARTIAL: ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Kidneys & urinary tract
regions.space_effect: Changes in calcium metabolism and hydration can influence the risk of stones.
regions.how_measured: Symptoms, fluid balance, ultrasound and urine tests if available.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.resources_note: Urine dipsticks: quantity 0 in the demo.

regions.name: Blood, immunity & radiation
regions.space_effect: Spaceflight can alter immune responses (herpesvirus reactivation in 61% of ISS crew); radiation is a mission risk (about 1.8 mSv/day measured in transit to Mars; career limit 600 mSv, NASA-STD-3001).
regions.how_measured: Mission dosimetry; temperature; lab tests (HemoCue, Bio-Analyzer) only if available.
regions.how_often: As the mission protocol says; no validated universal schedule.
regions.if_amber: DEMO: check the trend, data quality and resources; request an assessment as the protocol says.
regions.if_red: DEMO: start the emergency protocol and a medical consultation if there are serious signs; no automatic diagnosis.
regions.resources_note: HemoCue does not confirm immunity; no dosimeter inventoried.
regions.status: PARTIAL: ALERTS AND FREQUENCY NOT VALIDATED

regions.name: Skin
regions.space_effect: Humidity, friction and the closed environment can favour skin problems.
regions.how_measured: Inspection and clinical photos with a scale, with consent, as the protocol says.
